expected_results: Migration 0031 is ADDITIVE + REVERSIBLE: CreateModel StaffWithdrawalCorrelation (+ M2M to discovery candidates) and three AlterField choice additions (Withdrawal.correlation_method += MANUAL_STAFF; UnknownSenderDiscoveryCandidate.review_state += CORRELATED; DiscoveryCandidateAction.action tracks the same choices). No data migration; no destructive change.

A NAMED active-staff reviewer can, via `correlate_withdrawal_candidates` with an EXPLICIT --broker-profile-id, confirm two+ reference-less discovery candidates are ONE withdrawal lifecycle; --apply creates EXACTLY ONE REQUESTED / in-progress withdrawal (completed_at NULL, correlation_method MANUAL_STAFF, requested_at = earliest trusted timestamp), links provenance to both candidates and their evidence, and marks the candidates CORRELATED.

Fail-closed: non-staff reviewer, inactive/non-operator-verified/absent broker profile, candidate domain not a sender of the selected profile (broker mis-attribution), conflicting existing broker association, cross-tenant membership, ineligible/already-correlated/terminal-lifecycle candidate, conflicting recorded reference/amount/currency, ambiguous timestamp, duplicate or unknown candidate id — each REFUSES with a stable PII-free code and makes zero changes. The broker is never inferred/back-filled; a refusal never mutates a candidate's association.
Lifecycle truthfulness: the result is ALWAYS REQUESTED; "request successful" wording is never interpreted as COMPLETED; no processing duration is published.

Idempotency/concurrency: a deterministic idempotency key + its unique constraint make a replay (and a concurrent double-apply) a safe no-op — never a duplicate withdrawal; the decision is append-only (save/delete refuse rewrites).

Privacy: synthetic fixtures only; the decision stores only owner/broker FKs, salted message-id hashes, the user:<id> reviewer, a sanitised bounded reason and enums — no raw body/name/full-account/PII; command output is PII-free.
broker_intelligence suite green; makemigrations --check clean for broker_intelligence; ADR-0091 unique; migration rewind green; governance + secret + PII scans clean.
actual_results: makemigrations --check broker_intelligence: No changes detected (0031 captures the model + 3 choice AlterFields).

broker_intelligence.tests_staff_correlation: Ran 30 tests OK — positive (submitted+request-successful -> ONE REQUESTED withdrawal; timestamp ordering independent of candidate-id order; dry-run no-op via the command; --apply creates exactly one; replay idempotent; evidence preserved + provenance linked) and adversarial (cross-tenant; broker mis-attribution; conflicting broker association; non-staff + inactive reviewer; inactive + non-operator-verified + absent broker profile; conflicting reference; conflicting amount/currency; ambiguous timestamp; already-correlated; already-rejected; terminal-lifecycle refusal (never COMPLETED); too-few; duplicate id; not-found; TOCTOU ineligibility rollback; append-only save/delete; reason sanitisation; no-PII-fields-on-decision).

Full backend scope: Ran 1034 tests OK (1004 prior + 30 new) — no regression; the additive choice changes and the correlation.py MANUAL_STAFF exclusion broke no existing test. execution.tests_tb1_migration (migration rewind) and core.tests_adr_governance (ADR uniqueness incl. 0091) green.

Independent adversarial review (6-dimension multi-agent workflow + per-finding verification): 4 confirmed findings, all FIXED before PR with regressions — (HIGH) the ref-less, amount-bearing MANUAL_STAFF withdrawal was matchable by the automatic heuristic and could be silently advanced to COMPLETED; (MEDIUM) a later reference-carrying event could adopt it and stamp an unreviewed reference; (MEDIUM x2) the command did not catch an apply-time CorrelationRefused and a concurrent apply loser raised instead of returning the idempotent no-op. Fixes: exclude correlation_method=MANUAL_STAFF from correlation._heuristic_candidates (engine never advances/adopts a staff record); re-check the idempotency key UNDER the candidate lock before eligibility (concurrent loser -> no-op); the command catches apply-time CorrelationRefused. Regressions added: manual withdrawal stays REQUESTED after a later ref-less COMPLETED event; not adopted by a later reference event; command apply-time refusal is graceful; replay no-op even after candidates are CORRELATED.

PII review of the diff: synthetic only — fixtures use vantagemarkets.test / other-broker.test / *.guvfx.test / x.test, invented references REF-A/REF-B, amounts 100.00/250.00; no personal name, real email address, full account number, real reference or email body. Command output prints only owner_id/profile-id/candidate-ids/timestamp/truncated idempotency hash/user:<id>.

Scope: repository-only. The command was NOT applied in production and was NOT run against the genuine Vantage candidates 1/2; no production withdrawal, candidate/profile association, cursor or mailbox was touched.
limitations: Repository-only. Auto-merge OFF; NOT merged, NOT deployed, migration 0031 NOT applied in production without a separate explicit Sponsor GO. No production/DB mutation, no financial/broker action, no cursor movement, no mailbox read.

This control is an EXCEPTION PATH for reference-less brokers. It requires an explicit human staff decision per correlation; it does not and must not automatically merge candidates. When a broker later supplies a stable reference, the automatic reference-first engine handles it and this path is unnecessary.

Three existing fields gain a choice value via AlterField (Withdrawal.correlation_method, UnknownSenderDiscoveryCandidate.review_state, DiscoveryCandidateAction.action); these are additive and reversible and changed no existing test.

The manual withdrawal is reference-less and (unless a consistent amount/currency is already recorded in redacted evidence) amount-less, so the automatic reference-first/heuristic engine cannot later match or double-count it.
A pre-existing unrelated makemigrations drift in other apps on canonical main is not introduced or touched by this PR (broker_intelligence makemigrations --check is clean).
